build_CNNEncoder: build a CNN encoder that stacks Conv2d, MaxPool2d, and BatchNorm2d layers for image encoding
create_CNNEncoder_forward: create a forward pass through the CNN encoder to flatten a batch of image tensors
test_CNNEncoder_init: test the CNNEncoder constructor with matching input_dims, output_dims, and kernel_sizes lists
review_CNNEncoder_layers: review the CNNEncoder class to verify each layer uses Conv2d, LeakyReLU, MaxPool2d, and BatchNorm2d
refactor_CNNEncoder_padding: refactor the CNNEncoder to use configurable padding instead of kernel_size divided by two
